O mesmo pedido, em dois lugares diferent: The same request, in two different places.
No chat você digita, espera, copia e col: In chat, you type, wait, copy, and paste. If you close the window or the computer shuts off, the work in progress is gone. Ten tasks = ten waits with you sitting in front of it.
O pedido é gravado antes de rodar. No in: The request is saved before it runs. In inemaccbot, the queue is a SQLite database on disk; in the homemade queue, it's one file per task in a folder. Shut down? The task is still there.
Retoma o que ficou no meio: Picks up what was left halfway
Um trabalhador (worker) pega uma tarefa,: A worker takes a task, hands it to the agent, and waits. If the process crashes midway, the next time it starts up it recovers what was in flight before accepting new work.
Cada tarefa termina num estado claro: de: Each task ends in a clear state: it worked (with the file or text) or it failed (with the reason). That's what you check in the morning.
Rodar de novo só pega o que sobrou: Running again only picks up what's left
No inemaccbot o pedido chega pelo Telegr: In inemaccbot the request arrives through Telegram; in the homemade queue from lesson 3, it's a .md file in a folder. The idea is the same.
Por que isso deixa você sair de perto: Why this lets you walk away
Guardar antes de rodar, uma por vez, ret: Save before running, one at a time, resume after a crash, and keep done separate from failed: with these four guarantees, turning off the screen doesn't cost you any work.
O que você deve esperar de qualquer fila: What you should expect from any queue, homemade or not.
O pedido vira registro em disco no momen: The request becomes a record on disk the moment it arrives. It doesn't depend on an open window or on the program's memory.
No inemaccbot, cada pedido vira um <b>jo: In inemaccbot, each request becomes a job in a database table. It has a number (j13), a queue, a status, and how many attempts are left.
Você manda o pedido pelo celular, o comp: You send the request from your phone, the computer restarts, and the request is still on the list.
Cada trabalhador pega uma tarefa, termin: Each worker takes one task, finishes it, and only then takes the next. This prevents two jobs from fighting over the same machine.
No inemaccbot há cinco filas com limites: In inemaccbot there are five queues with different limits: the rendering queue runs one at a time on purpose, because it uses the graphics card; the network queue accepts ten.
Se o processo cai no meio, a tarefa não: If the process crashes midway, the task isn't lost or left half-done forever. The next time it starts up, whatever was in progress goes back to the queue.
O inemaccbot faz isso antes de aceitar t: inemaccbot does this before accepting new work and writes to the log: boot: recuperação de leases — requeued=N failed=M. Requeued is what went back to the queue; failed is what had already used up all its attempts.
Tarefa que deu erro não some e não trava: A task that hit an error doesn't vanish and doesn't block the queue: it goes to the failures side, with the reason written down, and the queue moves on.
Os prompts do inemaccbot exigem que o ag: The inemaccbot prompts require the agent to finish with RESULT: <path> or ERRO: <short reason>. That contract is what lets you know, without opening anything, how each task ended.
Os nomes mudam de uma fila para outra; a: The names change from one queue to another; the idea is the same.
fila/\n entrada/ # pedidos esperando:
fila/
  entrada/   # requests waiting their turn
  rodando/   # the task the agent is working on right now
  feito/     # request + answer
  falhou/    # request + ERRO and the reason
queued # na fila, esperando a vez\nru:
queued    # in the queue, waiting its turn
running   # a worker picked it up and is executing it
done      # finished with a result
failed    # ran out of attempts, with the reason
canceled  # you canceled it (/cancelar)

O miolo do fila-caseira.sh (resumido par: The core of fila-caseira.sh (condensed for reading)
mkdir -p \"$PASTA/entrada\" \"$PASTA/rod:
mkdir -p "$PASTA/entrada" "$PASTA/rodando" "$PASTA/feito" "$PASTA/falhou"

# resume: whatever was left in "rodando" (crash, Ctrl+C) goes back to the entrada
for f in "$PASTA"/rodando/*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] && mv "$f" "$PASTA/entrada/"; done

for f in "$PASTA"/entrada/*.md; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || { echo "fila vazia"; break; }
  nome=$(basename "$f")
  mv "$f" "$PASTA/rodando/$nome"          # grab the task (only one at a time)
  saida=$(claude -p "$(cat "$PASTA/rodando/$nome")" < /dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$saida" ]; then
    # request + --- + answer go to feito/
  else
    # request + ERRO (rc) + output go to falhou/
  fi
done
